verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is an API-first product, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The cited docs cover card creation, controls, webhooks, MCP and the CLI, which are unrelated to versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
